send.title: Send a request
send.body: Type a URL in the address bar and press Send. The response opens below it.

variables.title: Use variables
variables.body: Write a value as {{example}} and set it in an environment, so one request works for local, staging and production.

tools.title: Find every tool
tools.body: The Tools menu in the header groups what you can do with requests: run, mock, scan, monitor and share.

explore.title: Search anything
explore.body: Press {{shortcut}} for the command palette, or open Help and choose Explore features.
